title: Be a good guest in another team
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Understand the remit — Ask what the team owns and what it cannot readily change.; Follow one example — Observe how an actual piece of work moves through the team.; Offer a bounded option — State assumptions, ownership, and a way to evaluate it.; Leave useful context — Record decisions and commitments without creating dependence..
